name: Pimoroni Inky Impression 4"
description: 4 inch 6-colour Spectra 6 e-paper HAT for Raspberry Pi (Pimoroni SKU PIM789, current shipping variant, 600x400). Driven by the pi_bin client (fast 4-bpp packed buffer path). If you own the earlier 640x400 7-colour ACeP variant, use pimoroni_inky_4_acep instead.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware. The pi_png client is also compatible if you prefer the on-Pi quantise path; switch by configuring a `pi_png_client` device instance with the same panel preset.
